title: Single pullback comparisons respect square composition and module morphisms
statement: Choose shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with $g\prime\gg f=f\prime\gg g$. Let $N$ be an $\mathcal O_S$-module, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $a:f^*N\to M$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $E=N[0]$ and let $c:g\prime{}^*f^*N\cong f\prime{}^*g^*N$ be pullbackComp followed by pullbackCongr followed by inverse pullbackComp [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $d_E:Lf\prime{}^*Lg^*E\to Lg\prime{}^*Lf^*E$ be derived composition for $(f\prime,g)$ followed by transport along the square equality and inverse derived composition for $(g\prime,f)$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Write $p_b$ for canonicalSinglePullbackMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison]. In Lean composition order, $d_E\gg Lg\prime{}^*(p_f(N)\gg a[0])\gg p_{g\prime}(M)=Lf\prime{}^*(p_g(N))\gg p_{f\prime}(g^*N)\gg(c^{-1}\gg g\prime{}^*a)[0]$. This statement concerns pullbacks alone and does not assert a base-change or H-zero formula.

proof.text: Prove naturality of canonicalSinglePullbackMap by applying naturality to each of its three factors: the chosen derived counit on homotopy singles, the chain-level singleMapHomologicalComplex comparison followed by quotient and Qh, and the single embedding of the tensor-to-ordinary leftAdjointUniq comparison. Compose these three equalities without inverting any single comparison.

Apply the two-morphism composition identity to (g′,f). Precompose by its inverse derived composition and postcompose by the single map of inverse ordinary composition; cancel these composition isomorphisms. Transport canonicalSinglePullbackMap along h by equality elimination. Apply composition compatibility to (f′,g). Reassociate and combine the single functor maps, obtaining the square identity for N before the module morphism a.

Expand the derived pullback of canonicalSinglePullbackMap f N followed by a[0] using Functor.map_comp. Apply the proved naturality identity for g′ and a, substitute the square identity of the previous step, and combine the final single functor maps. The inverse ordinary square comparison is b′.hom followed by pullbackCongr(h).inv followed by b.inv, exactly the inverse of the displayed c.

lean.statement: theorem canonicalSinglePullbackSquare {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (N : S.Modules) (M : X.Modules) (a : (pullback f).obj N ⟶ M) : let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj N let c := (pullbackComp g' f).app N ≪≫ (pullbackCongr h).app N ≪≫ ((pullbackComp f' g).app N).symm let d := ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) f' g).hom.app E ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj E) h.symm) ≫ ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) g' f).inv.app E d ≫ (derivedPullback g').map (canonicalSinglePullbackMap f N ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).map a) ≫ canonicalSinglePullbackMap g' M = (derivedPullback f').map (canonicalSinglePullbackMap g N) ≫ canonicalSinglePullbackMap f' ((pullback g).obj N) ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map (c.inv ≫ (pullback g').map a)
